intro-basket: Look! Something is in the basket. Tap it!
intro-pom: It is a baby Fluffle! This is Pom. Pom cannot talk yet. Pom shows you what it wants in a bubble.
need-first: Pom wants something. Tap the dots, then slide along the arrow to read it.
need-next: Pom wants something new. Can you read it?
need-count: Pom is hungry again. Read the bubble.
hint-slide: Slide your finger along the arrow.
give-it: Can you give it to Pom?
take-pom: Pick Pom up, and take Pom to the place in the bubble.
hint-toybox: Look in the toy box. Tap it!
oops: Hmm. Not that one. Read the bubble again.
oops-place: Hmm. Pom does not want to go there. Read the bubble again.
bath-pop: Splash! Pop the bubbles in order. Start with number one.
hint-pop: Pop the bubbles in order. One, two, three, four, five, six.
yum-tub: Six bubbles! Pom wanted a bath in the tub.
plate: Put the buns on the plate. Then give the plate to Pom.
more: Pom is still hungry. Look at the number again.
too-many: Oh! Too many buns for Pom. Look at the number again.
yum-buns: Yum yum! Pom wanted three buns.
grow: Pom is growing up! Look, a new bed!
sleepy: Pom is sleepy. Take Pom to bed.
end: Well done! Come back soon, and see Pom grow.
sound-b: [pure sound /b/ as in bun, short, no 'uh' after it]
sound-n: [pure sound /n/ as in nut, held: nnn]
sound-h: [pure sound /h/ as in hat, a breath with no 'uh']
sound-t: [pure sound /t/ as in tub, whispered, no 'uh']
sound-s: [pure sound /s/ as in sun, held: sss]
